title: Read Aloud
editor.placeholder: Paste or type text here, then press Play. Or highlight text anywhere and press Super+Alt+R (turn the shortcut on below).
note.private: Private: text stays in memory only and is forgotten on Clear or after 10 minutes idle. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere.
note.offline: The Read Aloud service is not running. Press Play to start it, or run: systemctl --user start omarchy-read-aloud
setup.text: Read Aloud needs a one-time setup: it installs the voice engine in your home folder and downloads the Kokoro voice model (165 MB). If Bun isn't installed, it asks for your password to install it. After that, nothing goes online.
setup.updateText: This version of Read Aloud has a new engine. Update it to keep reading.
uninstall.confirm: Remove Read Aloud completely? This removes the engine, the voice model, the service, the shortcut and this plugin. Bun stays installed.
